title: Modify app description and update 'byop' status
author: gggff123
pr_body_excerpt: Fixes Automated video app as requested by @achmez in #14077

gist.headline: The app garden got labels
gist.blurb: The Automated Video app got its little signpost refreshed and its BYOP status brought back in line. Even garden directories need occasional weeding.
gist.summary: Updated the Automated Video app entry in operations/app-management/app.json, including its description and BYOP status, so the app directory reflects its current setup.
gist.impact: Users browsing the app directory will see clearer Automated Video app information and an accurate BYOP availability status.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a friendly app-garden caretaker replacing the sign on a small automated video workstation, with a retro monitor showing a simple film strip and a neatly updated BYOP badge. Use code-plants and flowers to represent the managed app directory.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener hat, carefully updating a sign beside a retro video-editing monitor with a small film strip icon and a pixel badge reading “BYOP.” Code-plants and flowers grow around the workstation against a prominent soft lime green (#ecf874), mint, lavender, and warm cream gradient; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
